Theorem 1 (Chapter 129)

Subject: quantum thermodynamics | ID: 7670

Assertion

Step 2. Consider the idempotent operator \(B_{01290012}\) acting on the symmetric space. By the idempotent decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|B_{01290012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01290012\).

Step 3. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|W_{01290013}|^p) \leq C_01290013\) follows from the parabolic Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through linear approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
